cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: {faction} like us well enough now. I want it made official: Partners. Partners don't undercut each other, and they warn you when someone's coming for you. I'll take that over a handshake.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want {faction} as Partners, which means their opinion of us has to hold up. A Partner takes your side on price and tips you off when it turns nasty. We'd be a firm with friends, and that's worth money.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Time we made {faction} Partners. They already like us, so this is only about doing it properly. More favours, a proper gift. Then we've a firm at our back when the knives come out.
